notes: Replaced two-pass validation (find+early-return / loop+unreachable arm) with single-pass collect-then-iterate using as_str().ok_or(v).collect::<Result<Vec<_>, _>>(). The second loop now iterates over &str directly, no never-taken fallback arm. Applied in both principal.rs and notification.rs.
title: Destroy-array validation has redundant 'unreachable' continue arm — collect-or-validate is more idiomatic
